description.zh: 看清单幅图的线条与留白，再回原页核对文件类型和许可。 Diana Valeanu 独立创作的手绘插画资源项目，按系列和章节组织，提供 PNG 与 SVG。免费资源仅非商业且需署名链接；付费会员和单章授权分别限会员有效期与购买后一年，到期停止使用，另有用途禁限；下载文件尚未实取。
description.en: An independent hand-drawn illustration project by Diana Valeanu, organized into series and chapters with PNG and SVG files. Free resources are for non-commercial use with attribution and an active link. Paid memberships are licensed only during membership, and individual chapters for one year after purchase; use must stop after expiry. Further restrictions apply. Downloaded files have not been obtained.
